description: LLM inference optimisation decomposed. The mechanics of serving production LLMs at scale. KV cache management (paged attention, prefix caching). Continuous batching. Speculative decoding. Tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism. vLLM, TGI, SGLang as production serving systems.

sub_mechanisms.name: prefill_phase
sub_mechanisms.definition: Process input prompt: compute K, V for all input tokens in parallel. One forward pass.
sub_mechanisms.why: Embarrassingly parallel: all tokens visible. Compute-bound (matmul). Output: KV cache populated; sample first output token.

sub_mechanisms.name: decode_phase
sub_mechanisms.definition: Generate tokens one at a time. Each step: append new token to context, compute attention using KV cache.
sub_mechanisms.why: Sequential: each token depends on previous. Memory-bound: dominated by reading KV cache. Different optimisation profile than prefill.

sub_mechanisms.name: KV_cache_memory_size
sub_mechanisms.definition: Per request: 2 × layers × heads × head_dim × seq_len × precision. Typical: 1-10 MB per token.
sub_mechanisms.why: LLaMA-70B: ~80 KB per token per request. 4K context: ~320 MB per request. Memory dominates LLM serving cost. KV cache management is the central problem.

sub_mechanisms.name: paged_attention
sub_mechanisms.definition: vLLM: KV cache stored in fixed-size pages. Each request's logical pages map to physical pages.
sub_mechanisms.why: Like OS virtual memory. Eliminates fragmentation: short + long requests share pool efficiently. ~2x throughput vs naive KV management.

sub_mechanisms.name: prefix_caching
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cache KV for shared prompt prefixes across requests. System prompts, RAG context.
sub_mechanisms.why: Common prefix → reused KV. Skip prefill for shared part. 5-10x speedup when many requests share system prompt. Production-essential.

sub_mechanisms.name: continuous_batching
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dynamic batch: new requests join + finished requests leave at each iteration step.
sub_mechanisms.why: Static batching: must wait for slowest request. Continuous: GPU always full. ~3x throughput vs static. Standard in vLLM, TGI, SGLang.

sub_mechanisms.name: speculative_decoding
sub_mechanisms.definition: Small draft model proposes K tokens; large target verifies in parallel. Accept matched tokens; reject from first mismatch.
sub_mechanisms.why: Target's parallel forward pass over K tokens cheaper than K sequential. 2-3x decode speedup when draft accuracy >70%. Used in production.

sub_mechanisms.name: tensor_parallelism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Split each layer across GPUs: each holds slice of weights; all-reduce for cross-slice communication.
sub_mechanisms.why: Larger-than-single-GPU models. LLaMA-70B fits across 4 GPUs via TP. Communication-heavy: NVLink needed for efficient TP.

sub_mechanisms.name: pipeline_parallelism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Split layers across GPUs: each holds contiguous block. Tokens flow through pipeline.
sub_mechanisms.why: Less communication than TP. Cost: bubble (some GPUs idle during transitions). Hybrid TP+PP standard for very large models.

sub_mechanisms.name: weight_quantization_inference
sub_mechanisms.definition: Reduce inference weight precision: GPTQ (4-bit), AWQ (4-bit), Marlin (4-bit fused).
sub_mechanisms.why: Smaller model fits in memory; faster matmul. <1% quality loss on 4-bit. Standard for production deployment + consumer hardware.

sub_mechanisms.name: chunked_prefill
sub_mechanisms.definition: Split long prefill into chunks; interleave with decode steps from other requests.
sub_mechanisms.why: Long prefill blocks decode requests. Chunking lets system serve mix. vLLM, SGLang implement. Tradeoffs in scheduling complexity.

sub_mechanisms.name: streaming_token_output
sub_mechanisms.definition: Send tokens to client as they're generated. Lower TTFT (time to first token) perception.
sub_mechanisms.why: User UX: see partial output immediately. Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol standard. ChatGPT, Claude, all chatbot UIs use this.

derivation_rules.name: KV_cache_memory_dominates_LLM_serving
if: model serves multiple concurrent long-context requests
derivation_rules.why: LLaMA-70B 4K context: 320 MB per request. 100 requests: 32 GB. KV cache > model weights. Memory bound; not compute bound. Driving force behind PagedAttention + efficient KV management.

derivation_rules.name: continuous_batching_3x_static_batching
derivation_rules.definition: Continuous batching keeps GPU 80-90% utilised vs static 30-50%.
if: batching is dynamic instead of fixed
then: throughput is ~3x higher at similar latency
derivation_rules.why: Static: padded to longest, wait for slowest. Continuous: each iteration step decides. Per-iteration scheduling overhead; gains massive in heterogeneous workloads. Standard since vLLM 2023.

derivation_rules.name: paged_attention_eliminates_KV_fragmentation
if: KV cache uses fixed-size pages with logical-to-physical mapping
derivation_rules.why: Without paging: each request reserves max length even if it ends short. With paging: only used pages occupied. ~2x effective memory; ~2x throughput. vLLM's central innovation.

derivation_rules.name: prefix_caching_amortises_system_prompts
then: KV cache for prefix is computed once + shared
derivation_rules.why: System prompt 1K tokens × 100 requests = 100K prefill tokens normally. With prefix caching: 1K total. 100x speedup for the prefill phase on shared prefix. RAG + tool-use deployments depend on this.

derivation_rules.name: speculative_decoding_2x_decode_when_draft_accurate
if: draft model agrees with target ≥70% of tokens
derivation_rules.why: K-token speculation: target verifies K in parallel forward pass. If 7 of 10 accepted: ~7 tokens per target forward. Free wins for matched tokens. Production: small model (1-7B) drafting for large (70B+) target.
